semantics.experiment: For a fixed row-class stabilizer partition, only allow whole-block operations. A column class is structurally reachable iff the selected cell has total partial occupancy P=0 under the matrix selection rule.
semantics.selection_rule: First minimize total partial occupancy P; then minimize total occupied orbit count; then maximize full occupancy F.
semantics.rows: Each row uses only rep1 stabilizer partition of that class.
semantics.columns: Each column traverses all distinct group-orbit instances of rep1 for that class.
